Clayshire Castle
Bed & Breakfast
Medieval Accommodations in Rural Indiana
Escape the chaos and stress of the modern world at Clayshire Castle, a medieval-style bed and breakfast in the tranquil countryside of western central Indiana. Here our guests are treated like royalty with luxurious accommodations, gourmet breakfast, and unique surroundings.
Book Now
Our Accommodations
Clayshire Castle is the perfect medieval getaway in the heart of Indiana. Choose from five uniquely-themed guest rooms in our 10,000 square foot castle, and enjoy gourmet breakfast each morning. Each room has a queen size bed and pull-out sofa for accommodating up to four guests.
The Tournament Room features heraldic decor and a royal canopy bed. The Enchanted Forest Room has a rustic stone fireplace and an ornate antique curtained bed. The Fairy Tale room is decorated with artwork from famous fairy tales and has a mermaid-themed bathroom. The Tapestry room showcases reproductions of the famous Lady and the Unicorn tapestry. Finally, our basement Wine Cellar room has a vineyard theme and features a custom-built wine barrel tub.
For more information on our luxury accommodations or to schedule a massage with your reservation, give us a call. We'll be glad to answer your questions.
Learn More
Great Hall
The Clayshire Castle's Great Hall is the perfect venue for weddings, receptions, banquets, and other special events. The two story Great Hall can accommodate up to 60 guests.
Medieval dinners can be provided by special arrangement for groups of 10 to 20 guests. Call for pricing and rental requirements. Menu contains gluten and dairy and cannot be modified .
Please note that we cannot accommodate pets under any circumstances.
For more information, visit our Great Hall page, or give us a call.
Learn More
Common Areas and Amenities
Clayshire Castle has a number of common areas for all our guests to enjoy, including a library filled with medieval books, a basement game room with board games and DVDs, and an exercise room with aerobic machines and hand weights. We also have a fantastic collection of medieval-period costumes for our guests to enjoy.
Library
Curl up with a good book. We have something for everyone - classics, medieval references, mysteries, children's books, and more.
Basement Game Room
Grab a board game or select a DVD. The kitchenette has popcorn and beverages. There's even a kids' playroom (supervision required).
Costume Room
Make your stay even more memorable by wearing a medieval outfit! We have over 100 costumes in all sizes, including for children.
Exercise Room
Need to keep up your workout routine? The exercise room is equipped with hand weights, treadmill, elliptical, stationary bike, and TV.
Attractions
Bowling Green, Indiana is located between Indianapolis and Terre Haute, just south of I-70. We're just minutes from some of Indiana's best natural attractions.
McCormick's Creek State Park, Indiana's oldest state park, has some of the best hiking trails in the state, as well as a scenic limestone canyon, waterfalls, picnic areas, and playground. Lieber State Recreation Area includes Cagles Mill Lake and Cataract Falls (the largest waterfall in Indiana), and is the perfect spot for outdoor activities such as fishing, boating, and bird watching.
Also nearby is the Exotic Feline Rescue Center, where you can see tigers, lions, and other large cats up close. Just a short drive away is the town of Spencer, Indiana - home to a variety of restaurants, a local winery, a charming historic movie theater, and golf course.
Learn More
Castle Grounds
When you stay at Clayshire Castle, you have access to over 100 wooded acres and all of the property's unique attractions. We have a number of quiet walking trails, a hedge maze, a lawn-chess area, and a fully stocked pond. And, if you're in the mood for relaxing under the stars, you can take a soak in our outdoor cedar hot tub . All this is just part of what makes Clayshire Castle such a great place to stay.
Walking Trails
Grab you hiking shoes and explore the trails through the secluded woods on our property's 120 pristine acres.
Hedge Maze
Test your navigational skills by winding your way through our [somewhat] challenging hedge maze.
Lawn Chess
Enjoy a good game of chess, especially with very, very large pieces? Then, try out our lawn chess set.
Stocked Pond
Our pond is 3.5 acres, and it includes an island on the south side. Perfect for fishing, exploring, or simply relaxing for a while.
Medieval Faire & Other Events
At Clayshire Castle, we hold a number of public events during the year. The annual Medieval Faire, our largest event, is your opportunity to go back in time to the Wars of the Roses in Medieval England. Enjoy great food and fantastic entertainment. You'll also have the chance to shop at the marketplace, which features handmade arts and crafts by local artisans.
Check our Events page regularly for upcoming attractions to be held at Clayshire Castle.

Policies
CLAYSHIRE CASTLE POLICIES
Policies
Reservations
Room reservations can be made on-line up to a year in advance. If you experience any problems in making or checking on your reservation, please contact us directly. Payment is due in full at the time of booking. Indiana sales tax is 7%.
Check-in/Check-out
You may check in after 4:00pm. If you need early or late check in, please call in advance to make arrangements. Check out is at 11:00am.
Cancellations/Reschedules
A refund is available up to 14 days prior to the reserved date less a $25 cancellation fee. Cancellations within 14 days of the reserved date are non-refundable. Any change in reservation dates will incur a $25 rescheduling fee.
Restrictions
The castle is a non-smoking environment but smoking is permitted outside and away from doorways. Smoking inside will incur a $250 cleaning charge per violation.
Children & Pets
Well-behaved children are welcome; please let us know how many children are coming (and their ages) when you make your reservation so we can plan for breakfast. Sorry, but we cannot accommodate pets/animals under any circumstances.
Other
Massage requests must be made a minimum of 2 weeks prior to your stay.
Please let us know if you have any dietary restrictions.
ARRIVAL TIMES 4:00 PM - 10:00 PM
If arriving outside of check-in times, please call to make arrangements.
AUTO-COLLECT
At the time of booking, 100% of the reservation balance will be collected. Payment for all retail items and gift certificates will also be collected. Applies to: all reservations.
CREDIT CARD SECURITY
Your credit card information is stored and processed securely.
